tool_input.command:
cat > /tmp/test-spec.md << 'EOF'
# Spec: Test

## 1. Objective

Test the gate.

## 5. Responsible AI Gate

### 5.1 Risk tier

- **Tier**: limited
- **Justification**: Simple test
- **Sign-off**: not required

### 5.2 Data provenance & privacy

- **Data sources**: internal only
- **PII involved?**: no
- **Retention**: 30 days
- **Used for training?**: no

### 5.3 Human oversight

- **Automation level**: assistive
- **Override path**: manual override available
- **Kill switch**: feature flag enabled

### 5.4 Evaluation plan

- **Pre-ship metrics & thresholds**: accuracy >= 0.9
- **Eval dataset**: test-set.jsonl
- **Who runs it and when**: CI on changes

### 5.5 Bias & fairness

- **Groups at risk**: none identified
- **Mitigations**: standard testing
- **How tested**: standard metrics

### 5.6 Monitoring & rollback

- **Production monitoring**: standard metrics
- **Degradation definition**: accuracy drops below 0.85
- **Rollback trigger & procedure**: manual rollback available

### 5.7 Transparency & incidents

- **User disclosure**: labeled as AI
- **Incident owner**: support team
- **Incident path**: standard escalation
EOF
pnpm --filter frai-gate exec -- node dist/cli.js check /tmp/test-spec.md --summary

claude.result:
Perfect! The feature is complete and fully tested. Here's a summary of what I've implemented:

## Implementation Summary

### 1. Added `renderSummary()` function (`src/gate/report.ts`)
- Returns one-line summary: `<VERDICT> <answered>/<total>` format
- `answered` = checks with no block-severity findings
- Appends block-finding check IDs in GATE_CHECKS order when blocks exist
- Special case: `BLOCK 0/7: structure` when gate section is missing

### 2. Added `--summary` flag to CLI
- Prints only the summary line instead of full report
- Exit codes unchanged (1 = BLOCK, 0 = PASS/WARN)
- `--json` takes priority if both flags are given

### 3. Updated HELP text
- Documented the new `--summary` flag with example output

### 4. Added comprehensive tests
- 7 new test cases in `src/gate/report.test.ts` covering:
  - Missing gate section
  - No findings (PASS)
  - Warning-only findings
  - Single and multiple block findings
  - Deduplicated check IDs
  - Mixed block and warn findings

### 5. Verification
- ✅ All 18 tests pass (7 new + 11 existing)
- ✅ Build succeeds with no errors
- ✅ Tested with real specs: works as expected

Example outputs:
- `PASS 7/7` — all checks answered
- `BLOCK 5/7: evaluation, transparency` — blocks in check order
- `BLOCK 0/7: structure` — missing gate section
